'''Stadium Five''' was a sporting stadium located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Eusebus]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Euceron]]. During the [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]] of [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]], the stadium hosted a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] obstacle course event.<ref name="Dangerous Game" />
